name: Arc Ctrl+Tab
description: Arc-style Ctrl+Tab tab switcher in most-recently-used order. Turns on Zen's built-in switcher and restyles it with your theme's colors. Settings: hold-Ctrl or stay-open mode, thumbnail grid, plain list, or list with a large preview, unloaded tabs shown muted, sizes and highlight color. Turn off other Ctrl+Tab panel mods.
author: dvgmdvgm

JS/arc-ctrltab.uc.js.name: Arc Ctrl+Tab
